newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN MUTUAL FUND ASSETS UP 3.7 PCT IN Q4 1996.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN MUTUAL FUND ASSETS UP 3.7 PCT IN Q4 1996.

text.p: The volume of Belgian and foreign investment funds under management by Belgium's unit trust industry rose 3.7 percent in the fourth quarter of 1996, the Belgian Mutual Fund Association (BMFA) said on Tuesday.

The total amount outstanding of Belgian and foreign funds offered on the Belgian market on December 31, 1996, rose by 80.4 billion Belgian francs to 2,253.4 billion francs, the BFMA said in a statement.
The BMFA said growth was largely due to the success of capital-guaranteed index funds.
The 15 new funds launched in this market segment contributed 33.5 billion Belgian francs in fresh capital to the sector, BMFA said.
